object_files.description: List of object files and/or libraries to process.

include_object_files.description: Include in the cross reference listing the name of object files.

include_source_files.description: Include in the cross reference listing the names of the source files.

include_xref_source_files.description: Include in the cross reference listing the name of source files in which used symbols are defined.

show_full_symbols.description: Show the full names of the symbols.

call_tree_function.description: The function name to start the call tree from.

called_by_function.description: The function name to start the called-by overview from.

no_cross_reference.description: Prevent the cross-reference information from being written to stdout.

output_abbreviation.description: Mode specifies the way the output is abbreviated: count, first, or len.

select_name.description: Initial substring of a symbol to select.
